name: Ganga
astrological_significance: Taking a dip in the Ganga is believed to nullify all negative karmas (Pitra Dosha, Kaal Sarp Dosha).
remedy_association: Used universally for all planetary afflictions.

name: Yamuna
astrological_significance: Bathing in the Yamuna is highly recommended for remedies related to Venus (Shukra) and relationship doshas.
